determinism.note: the writer is run twice on the same inputs and the DWGs compared byte for byte; no header field is pinned

evidence_statement: KNOWN_TRUTH_EXACT here means one thing: the DWG bytes, decoded by three open readers, carry the authored mathematics, exactly where the DWG stores it verbatim and within PVec numeric policy v1 where it stores a derived value. There is no STEP oracle: no STEP file was produced, read or compared, and nothing here says how any converter treats these drawings.

self_contained: this directory holds every DWG, every read record and a hash-pinned copy of each authored record and parameter file; nothing outside it is needed to run `check`
writer_source: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 dwgwrite (the build of the pvec-oracle-libredwg image: the stock source plus its one patch, which only changes how dwgread prints doubles), run as a separate process on JSON that tools/corpus/writer-libredwg/author.py writes from the authored expected.math.json records and the parameter files. dwgwrite is invoked as 'dwgwrite --as r2000|r2004 -I JSON'. LibreDWG refuses r2007 and does not write r2010 and later reliably (its manual: those formats still fail CRC and audit checks), so R2000 (AC1015) and R2004 (AC1018) are the only versions this family covers.
